resume: Generative ambient firmware built on Felucca 1.6.1: four editable layers drawn from 64 sound recipes, 24 worlds, 24 motifs and 32 scales. GROW varies the phrases, and seven EVOLVE processes change them over time.

commandes.role: In GROW, steps back one step unless a new phrase edit has invalidated it; in EVOLVE, locks the phrase.
Applies the current choice: WORLD, MOTIF, and GROW.
Opens the Bunker home page; with SELECT, picks the view WORLD, GROW, SOUND, MOTIF, EVOLVE or MIX.
With HOME, picks the view among WORLD, GROW, SOUND, MOTIF, EVOLVE and MIX.
Picks the track on the home page.

modes.texte: K1 sets the root, K2 the scale, K3 the mode TUNE, SOFT, FLOW or NEW, K4 the selected track or all tracks. OCT+ applies, OCT- undoes the last step. Drums and slices are ignored.

a_savoir: Felucca's EDIT, ENV, LFO, FX, SCL, ARP, SEQ and SAVE pages remain available and act on the same tracks.
Bunker projects (114 parameters) are not read by Felucca 1.6.1, and those from AMB or Wolf are not carried over.
